args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY AGENTS BY CAPABILITY:

Payroll & Compensation (Workday HCM):
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation - processes merit increases, compensation adjustments based on performance and policies; integrates payroll cycles
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationChangeProcessor - automates compensation adjustments tied to org changes; validates against benefit eligibility & payroll timelines
- workday.hcm:agent:CompensationStructureAutomationEngine - monitors org structure changes, updates compensation plans, recalibrates benefit structures

Incident/Case Lifecycle Management:
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator - tracks incident lifecycle through resolution, coordinates response workflows, escalation
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes incidents, generates diagnostic reports

Incident tracking & reporting (Safety/EHS):
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes safety incidents for root causes, corrective actions
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator - coordinates safety incident workflows

Procurement/Supplier expenses:
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent - matches requisitions to vendors by cost/quality
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI - REST API for PO lifecycle
- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation - autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs/contracts, flags discrepancies via 3-way matching

Production Compliance:
- my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator - monitors vendor compliance, material inspections
- my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator - validates BOM compliance
- sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent - automates compliance verification

TYPICAL WORKFLOW PATTERNS:
1. Incident analysis → lifecycle tracking: IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer → IncidentSafetyCoordinator
2. Case resolution workflow: Use IncidentSafetyCoordinator for updating/tracking stuck cases
3. Supplier billing reconciliation: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation (validates quantities, pricing, terms; flags exceptions/overbilling)
4. Payroll/Benefit review: Use CompensationAdjustmentAutomation for accessing & reviewing payroll structures and benefit allocations

args.reason: This agent directly manages compensation structures, integrates with payroll cycles, and provides audit trails suitable for fiscal payroll and benefit allocation reviews.
